title: betterado_extension_install: framework-native ADO Marketplace extension management
essence: Adds betterado_extension_install (terraform-plugin-framework resource) to install/uninstall ADO Marketplace extensions at the organisation level via the ExtensionManagement API, registered exclusively on the framework provider (mux-free-ready). Includes a gap matrix clarifying the boundary with the existing betterado_extension SDKv2 resource, a live acceptance test with CaptureLiveEvidence, tfplugindocs-generated docs, and CHANGELOG/version bump.
